notes.title: Demo v0.1.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Updates
Crafter recipes now use the same visual style as the new resource boxes for consistency.

Tutorial 1 now includes guidance on using time controls and how to progress through tutorial messages.

Message texts now advance at 400% speed for improved pacing.

Added a VSync toggle to the settings panel.

Players can now choose a target frame rate: 30, 60, 144, or unlimited.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the game would not exit road placement mode when unpaused via the time speed buttons or tutorial message box. This previously caused drone logic to break.

Resolved a bug where modules could stop functioning if a drone gathering resources was unassigned. Drones already carrying or about to carry resources will now be the last to be unassigned.
